selected_problem: Fresh-main changeset path normalization still preserved a trailing slash for file targets. Workspace resolution treated node/ and node as the same file, but the staged receipt retained node/, and Git pathspec delivery for a regular file named node rejects node/.
decision_basis: The defect is a narrow canonical path identity mismatch across stage/apply/delivery and is directly reproducible without selecting new architecture.
ChangesetStore targets regular files only and already canonicalizes dot and parent segments, so removing trailing separators reuses the existing file-identity invariant.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained unavailable with transient HTTP 502; this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.

pre_fix_reality.workspace_identity: WorkspaceService resolves node/ to the regular file node
pre_fix_reality.git_delivery_reproduction: git add -- node/ returned exit 128 for a regular file named node

change: ChangesetStore.stage removes trailing separators after POSIX lexical normalization, so node/, node// and node share the canonical file identity node before duplicate/overlap checks and receipts.

validation.pre_fix_git_pathspec: PASS: node/ reproduced fatal pathspec mismatch on a regular file
validation.focused_normalization: PASS: node/ and node// normalize to node; ordinary paths stay unchanged; traversal remains rejected by the existing gate
validation.normalized_git_pathspec: PASS: git add -- node succeeds on the same file reality

truth_boundary: This closes trailing-separator lexical identity drift for file changesets. It does not claim filesystem case/Unicode equivalence, filesystem crash atomicity, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
